completion: I don’t have feelings in the way people do, so I don’t “like” or “dislike” music in a personal sense. But I’ve been trained on a huge amount of musical content—from classical scores and jazz improvisations to pop hits and experimental noise—so I can discuss, analyze, and even help generate music. Whether it’s exploring how a chord progression creates tension, breaking down the structure of a song, or finding a playlist that matches a mood, I’m happy to dive into all things music. What kind of music are you into right now?
